scripts.build: npm run build -w @bank-ai/contracts && npm run build -w @bank-ai/addin && npm run build -w @bank-ai/local-runtime && npm run build -w @bank-ai/desktop-host
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bank-ai/contracts && npm run build -w @bank-ai/addin && npm run dev -w @bank-ai/local-runtime
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bank-ai/contracts && npm run build -w @bank-ai/local-runtime && npm run typecheck -w @bank-ai/addin && npm run typecheck -w @bank-ai/desktop-host
scripts.test: npm run build -w @bank-ai/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w @bank-ai/desktop-host
